title: Prism's Crosshair O-1
description: Changes the classic original crosshair into a smooth sqaure crosshair, good for pvp.
body:
![Text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/011959ee0ff15e250cd362e4a84c6b66405ee0d4.png)
## Sqaure Precision Crosshair

**Enchance your aiming accuracy with the _Sqaure Precision Crosshair_, a clean and modern redesign focused on clarity and consistency.**

**This crosshair replaces the _original design_ with a _sharp_, _sqaure-shaped_ _reticle_, providing better visual alignment and improved target tracking.**
